pressConfigurations.name: Mega-Scale Continuous Automated Industrial Tortilla Press (3,200 Dozen/Hr, 60 Ton Hydraulic Clamp, Dual 230°C Electric Platens)
pressConfigurations.description: Continuous high-throughput industrial flour tortilla line utilizing electro-hydraulic proportional valves and dual 230°C heated cast-alloy platens. Radiative and conductive thermal soak into cylinder glands requires advanced fluoropolymer sealing and active fluid cooling.

pressConfigurations.name: Mid-Scale Wholesale Commercial Bakery Tortilla Press (1,400 Dozen/Hr, 40 Ton Hydraulic Clamp, Gas-Fired Platens)
pressConfigurations.description: High-production regional bakery press heated by ribbon gas burners underneath cast iron platen beds. Secondary radiant convective heat plumes elevate ambient temperature around the lower hydraulic cylinder rod packing.

pressConfigurations.name: Compact In-Store Supermarket & Taqueria Tortilla Press (600 Dozen/Hr, 25 Ton Clamp, Dual Heated Platens)
pressConfigurations.description: Storefront automated press engineered for fresh masa and flour tortillas. Compact chassis confines the hydraulic pump and cylinder near heating elements with limited heat-dissipation airflow.

pressConfigurations.name: Heavy High-Tonnage Double-Stage Press (2,200 Dozen/Hr, 75 Ton Hydraulic Clamping, 240°C Cast Platens)
pressConfigurations.description: Ultra-heavy dual-action press for high-gluten artisan wraps and multi-grain tortillas requiring extreme pressing tonnage. Severe hydraulic pressure spikes occur during hard dough compaction strokes.

pressConfigurations.name: Legacy 18-Year Industrial Tortilla Press (Deteriorated Wire-Braid Hoses, Uncooled Power Unit)
pressConfigurations.description: Aging commercial installation with uninsulated flex hoses traversing directly over the top platen perimeter. Chronic thermal exposure has embrittled outer hose rubber, creating extreme pinhole rupture and atomization flash fire risks.

cylinderSealMaterials.name: Standard Nitrile Buna-N (NBR 70 Shore A - Max 100°C Continuous)
cylinderSealMaterials.description: Commodity elastomer commonly installed during generic rebuilds. Rapidly hardens, micro-cracks, and loses sealing resilience when exposed to platen radiant heat above 100°C.

cylinderSealMaterials.name: Hydrogenated Nitrile Elastomer (HNBR 80 Shore A - Max 145°C Continuous)
cylinderSealMaterials.description: Enhanced synthetic nitrile with saturated polymer backbone. Resists moderate temperature cycling and mechanical extrusion under cycling pressures up to 2,200 PSI.

cylinderSealMaterials.name: Fluoroelastomer Polymer (FKM / Viton A 80 Shore A - Max 204°C Continuous)
cylinderSealMaterials.description: Standard OEM specification for premium bakery machinery. Fluorocarbon structure maintains elasticity and compressive recovery despite direct radiant heating from 200°C+ platens.

cylinderSealMaterials.name: Perfluoroelastomer Compound (FFKM / Kalrez 85 Shore A - Max 300°C Extreme Thermal)
cylinderSealMaterials.description: Fully fluorinated elastomer providing near-inert thermal stability up to 300°C. Virtually impervious to thermal hardening, compression set, and oil degradation products.

hydraulicFluidClasses.name: NSF H1 Synthetic Polyalphaolefin (PAO ISO VG 32 Food-Grade, Open-Cup Flash Point 238°C)
hydraulicFluidClasses.description: Full synthetic food-grade hydrocarbon fluid meeting FDA 21 CFR § 178.3570 for incidental food contact. High viscosity index and oxidation resistance minimize thermal varnish deposition.

hydraulicFluidClasses.name: NSF H1 Fire-Resistant Synthetic Polyol Ester (ISO VG 46, Open-Cup Flash Point 295°C)
hydraulicFluidClasses.description: High-temperature synthetic ester engineered specifically for bakery ovens and heated presses. Exceptionally high flash point significantly mitigates atomized spray fire propagation.

hydraulicFluidClasses.name: Conventional Petroleum Anti-Wear Mineral Oil (ISO VG 32 Non-Food Grade, Flash Point 210°C)
hydraulicFluidClasses.description: Non-food-grade mineral hydraulic fluid prohibited around food contact zones. Severe hazard: leaks contaminate masa, while low flash point facilitates vapor ignition upon hot platen contact.

hydraulicFluidClasses.name: Thermally Degraded / Oxidized Acidic Hydraulic Oil (TAN > 2.8 mg KOH/g, Cracked Flash Point 155°C)
hydraulicFluidClasses.description: Fluid subjected to chronic thermal cycling without reservoir cooling. Light-end hydrocarbon cracking depresses flash point to 155°C, creating high risk of flash fire if sprayed across a 230°C platen.

protectiveEnclosureAndInterlocks.name: ISO 13849-1 PL-e Dual Monitored Hydraulic Safety Block, Cooled Heat Shielding & Fire Snubbing
protectiveEnclosureAndInterlocks.description: State-of-the-art bakery press installation. Stainless steel water-cooled thermal radiation deflector keeps cylinder gland under 90°C. Redundant safety valves prevent uncommanded platen descent.

protectiveEnclosureAndInterlocks.name: Standard Perforated Steel Guarding with Safety Light Curtain (OSHA 1910.212 Compliant)
protectiveEnclosureAndInterlocks.description: Standard regulatory safeguarding preventing operator hand intrusion during stroke. Provides partial spray deflection but lacks active thermal radiation baffles or automatic fire extinguishment.

protectiveEnclosureAndInterlocks.name: Unshielded Direct Radiant Exposure (No Thermal Baffle, Missing Hose Burst Sleeves)
protectiveEnclosureAndInterlocks.description: Severe OSHA violation. High-pressure hydraulic hoses and cylinder exposed to 230°C+ platen radiation. A ruptured hose atomizes pressurized fluid directly into the kitchen atmosphere.
